Two scripts were sending mail with `smtplib` directly: `scripts/order_reminder.py` and `scripts/nightly_summary.py`. Both now call `send(subject, body)` from `scripts/notify.py`, with the same subject, body and recipient as before.

Both scripts import cleanly, but I did not send any mail to check delivery.

The test suite has 2 failures out of 4, both in `tests/test_inventory.py` against `app/` inventory logic (`merge` and `low_stock`). They don't touch the scripts, so I left them alone:
- `test_merge_sums_repeats`: `merge` keeps the last quantity for a repeated item instead of summing.
- `test_low_stock_includes_threshold`: `low_stock` excludes items exactly at the threshold.

The ponytail plugin's statusline badge isn't configured; say so if you want me to add it to `settings.json`.
